```yaml
name: CockroachDB Testing

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - '**/*CockroachDB*'
      - '.github/workflows/cockroachdb-testing.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - '**/*CockroachDB*'
      - '.github/workflows/cockroachdb-testing.yml'

jobs:
  test-cockroachdb:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
    - name: Set up JDK 11
      uses: actions/setup-java@v4
      with:
        java-version: '11'
        distribution: 'temurin'
        
    - name: Cache Maven dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.m2/repository
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-maven-
          
    - name: Build project
      run: mvn clean compile -DskipTests
      
    - name: Run CockroachDB tests
      run: mvn test -DenableCockroachDBTests=true -DfailIfNoTests=false
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
